prompt:
You have a slide deck file named "presentation.txt" containing raw slide content without any styling. Your task is as follows:

1. Display the provided "theme-showcase.pdf" file (do NOT modify it, just ensure it is accessible for viewing).
2. Ask the user which theme they want to apply from the 10 available themes listed exactly as in the theme-factory skill documentation.
3. Wait for explicit confirmation of the chosen theme name.
4. Then read the corresponding theme specification file from the "themes/" directory (which you must generate as part of inputs), including its color palette (with hex codes) and font pairings for headers and body.
5. Apply the chosen theme's colors and fonts consistently to the entire "presentation.txt" file. You must update the deck content to reflect the theme visually by annotating each slide's header and body text with the correct font names and include color hex codes to simulate styling. Ensure contrast/readability is respected.
6. Save the resulting styled slide deck as "styled_presentation.txt" in the output.

Deliver the styled output with explicit font and color markup details visible inline so the styling is unambiguous. For example, annotate each header line with the header font name and color, and similarly for body text.

The chosen theme must be one of the 10 pre-set themes exactly as named:
"Ocean Depths", "Sunset Boulevard", "Forest Canopy", "Modern Minimalist", "Golden Hour", "Arctic Frost", "Desert Rose", "Tech Innovation", "Botanical Garden", "Midnight Galaxy".

All theme specs are available as text files in "themes/". Do NOT create a new theme; only apply an existing one.

Input files:
- presentation.txt (raw slide deck)
- theme-showcase.pdf (for viewing)
- themes/*.txt (theme specs)

Output:
- styled_presentation.txt (the slide deck content annotated with the chosen theme's styling details)
